Buildings bulletin 2022-005
ISSUED: March 10, 2022



   Zoning Requirements
   CELLULAR MONOPOLES
   To help achieve New York City’s goal of accelerating the buildout of 5G by issuing guidance to clarify
   standards for siting and placement of cellular monopoles that are available for mobile carriers to build out
   their networks, including those in underserved areas. It is expected that the 5G infrastructure will serve
   millions of New Yorkers across all five boroughs, expanding access to quality, high-speed, and reliable
   internet at home, at work or on the go.


   HIGHLIGHTS
   •   Cellular monopoles and related equipment
       may be filed as Use Group 6D under the New
       York City Zoning Resolution.

   •   Other installations that do not qualify as Use
       Group 6D may seek Special Permits by the
       Board of Standards and Appeals and the City
       Planning Commission

   •   Buildings Bulletin 2022-005 clarifies how
       the height and size of cellular monopoles and
       related equipment are measured and
       regulated.

   •   Information about non-substantial changes to

       equipment is addressed by Buildings

  BACKGROUND
   A cellular monopole is a single pole structure that serves no other purposes other than to support antennas
   and related equipment. A cellular monopole may be of varying heights.

   Read Buildings Bulletin 2022-005 for more details on the requirements.

   Send questions to constructioncodes@buildings.nyc.gov.
